solution.title: Epic Go-Live & Command Center Endpoint Readiness Playbook

products.name: Epic Go-Live & Command Center Endpoint Readiness Playbook — Commercial
products.short_description: Land an Epic go-live (or upgrade / new-site activation) with confidence — a playbook to get the clinical endpoint fleet ready, gate it through go/no-go, and run the command center during hypercare with rapid day-1 fix runbooks. Self-guided, tested.
products.description:
Ready the fleet, staff the command center, and land the Epic go-live

An Epic go-live is won or lost at the endpoint: if devices aren't ready and the command center isn't organized, day one becomes chaos — logins fail, printers don't print, devices aren't enrolled, and clinicians lose faith. This playbook gets the fleet ready and runs the event: a pre-go-live readiness sweep (Epic client version, printing, peripherals, Imprivata tap, login times, compliance), a measurable go/no-go gate, a command-center operating model (roles, tiers, dispatch, at-the-elbow support), rapid-fix runbooks for the top day-1 endpoint problems, and a clean hypercare-to-steady-state handover. (Deep per-component config lives in the Epic-client, Imprivata, and workstation-standardization solutions.)

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the readiness → go/no-go → command center → stabilize model.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Epic client/Imprivata/workstation standardization in place or scoped, Intune/Entra roles for validators, a device inventory, command-center staffing, comms/ticketing, the go-live date + scope) with how to verify and how to implement it if missing, plus the category Global Requirements.
  • Implementation Guide — build the readiness criteria + validation sweep, the go/no-go gate, the command-center operating model + dispatch, the rapid-fix runbooks, and the handover.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — fleet readiness snapshot, per-device go/no-go validation, readiness scorecard by unit, safe re-sync remediation for not-ready devices, and a readiness-group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with clear pass/fail gates (validated via a dry-run sweep), plus Best Practices for go-live command centers.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A clinical endpoint fleet proven ready before go-live, a go/no-go decision backed by data, a command center that resolves day-1 issues fast, and a clean handover to steady-state operations.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • EPICGOLIVE-Discovery.ps1 — EPICGOLIVE-Discovery — fleet readiness snapshot for an Epic go-live
    • EPICGOLIVE-Remediation.ps1 — EPICGOLIVE-Remediation — safe, supported remediation of endpoint readiness gaps
    • EPICGOLIVE-Report.ps1 — EPICGOLIVE-Report — readiness scorecard for an Epic go-live
    • EPICGOLIVE-Set-ReadinessGroup.ps1 — EPICGOLIVE-Set-ReadinessGroup — manage the readiness device group membership
    • EPICGOLIVE-Validation.ps1 — EPICGOLIVE-Validation — per-device go/no-go validation for an Epic go-live

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
